messages:
alice.ng: Heads-up: starting coordinated rollout v3.12.0 for runtime/api/console/router in change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need pins, release notes, and a short rollback playbook before api canary. deploy-bot will manage the staged rollout (5/25/50/100) with 10m holds. Please ACK and declare ownership. :rocket:

deploy-bot: [automated] Release tag v3.12.0 created. Canary plan id rb-361500. Initial canary group 5%, rollout schedule 5->25->50->100, 10m holds. Health checks wired to /health and synthetic probes.

ben: ack. I'll own router + api pinning and early rollback if router shows connection errors. Pinned commits:
- router: ff9a1b2
- api: 7c9d2ef
Commands I'll run: `rdctl pin router@ff9a1b2` and `rdctl pin api@7c9d2ef` before canary.

caroline: console has a migration for admin settings. I'll gate it under feature flag `console_new_admin_ui` and roll at 10% to start. Will also add migration notes to release doc. Signal me if we need to hold console.

dmitri: runtime included quant/kernel updates. Watch memory and p95. My rollback triggers proposal:
- sustained error rate > 0.5% over 5m
- p95 latency +200ms above baseline for 5m
- Any OOM on >1 instance within 10m
Rollback command (automated playbook):
```
./scripts/rollback_release.sh --service runtime --to-tag v3.11.9 --reason "auto-trigger"
```
I'll watch heap and JVMTI traces; paging to #incidents automatically on threshold.

eli: Drafted the release notes: https://docs.internal/releases/v3.12.0-draft. Highlights: kernel tuning, router connection pool improvements, console admin migration behind flag, API rate-limit changes. Need security sign-off on KMS tweak. Added KMS details in the notes for audit.

alice.ng: Noted. @dian please review KMS tweak by 03:30 UTC. If we don't have a hard deny, proceed but annotate in ticket. Also add a 1-paragraph rollback playbook to the release ticket (who runs what steps).

deploy-bot: [automated] router canary 5% started. Health checks: all passing. Monitor window open.

ben: router canary reports 200/200 checks, avg latency +10ms. Holding 10m. I'm watching error counts and connection resets.

deploy-bot: [automated] router canary stage complete OK. Advise next owner to begin api canary.

ben: starting api canary now: `rdctl rollout api@7c9d2ef --percent 5`.

deploy-bot: [automated] api canary 5% -> health OK. errors 0.02%, p95 +8ms vs baseline.

dmitri: runtime canary metrics: memory p95 +6%, p99 unchanged. No OOMs. I'm keeping the rollback thresholds active. :+1:

caroline: console flag set to 10% then bumped to 20% for integration checks. No client regressions noted. Added console.admin_ui_new rollout chart to dashboards.

ops-bot: Canary alerting armed. Thresholds: p95 latency, error-rate, OOM. Alerts to #incidents and on-call.

eli: Updated release notes with migration steps and known caveats. Added pointer to rollback playbook in ticket.

alice.ng: Checklist before progressing rollout:
1) pins confirmed for router + api
2) console feature flag in place
3) runtime dashboards open and paging configured
4) rollback script attached to ticket
If green, proceed to 25% at 02:35 UTC.

ben: All pins confirmed. Router and api pinned. Proceeding to 25% in 5m if no regressions.

deploy-bot: [automated] advancing rollout: router/api -> 25% (5m hold). Monitoring active.

dmitri: Observability note: keep an eye on KV cache miss rate during router scale; kernel bump changes prefetch behavior. If KV miss rate spikes >30% sustained, consider pause and investigate.

ben: Noted. Will pause if connection pool errors or >1% 5m error rate.

alice.ng: Reminder: whoever triggers rollback, paste the short reason and tag `@release-leads` and the ticket number here. We'll coordinate hotfix / re-deploy to v3.11.x if needed.

ops-bot: Rollout plan in progress. Next holds at 50% and 100% with 10m waits. Good luck team! :white_check_mark:
